CANONICAL_NAME.value: genann -- a minimal feedforward neural network in C (Lewis Van Winkle)

VERSION.value: github.com/codeplea/genann master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: The perceptron/MLP lineage (Rosenblatt 1958 -> Rumelhart backprop 1986): genann is a tiny ANSI C multilayer perceptron trained by backpropagation -- the connectionist update rule and forward pass in a few hundred readable lines

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: supervised learning of nonlinear functions by a connectionist network

value.built_to: learn a nonlinear input-output mapping from examples by adjusting connection weights via gradient descent (backpropagation) through a layered network
value.pressure: a mapping (like XOR) that no single linear unit can represent; the network must distribute the function across hidden units and learn the weights from data alone
value.success_means: the trained network generalises the target function (e.g. learns XOR, classifies IRIS) from examples

value.pressure: a nonlinearly-separable task, learning from examples only (no programmed rule)
value.failure_condition: failure to converge (bad learning rate / local minimum) or overfitting -- the net memorises noise and does not generalise

ANCESTRY.value: The perceptron/MLP lineage (Rosenblatt 1958 -> Rumelhart backprop 1986): genann is a tiny ANSI C multilayer perceptron trained by backpropagation -- the connectionist update rule and forward pass in a few hundred readable lines
